annotations.title: E-mail new vacancies to the user

description: Subscribes the user to e-mails about new NaRabotu vacancies for a search (profession, city, keywords, quick filters) — checked every 15 minutes, one-click unsubscribe in every e-mail. NaRabotu sends a 6-digit code to the user's e-mail; when the user tells you the code, call confirm_draft. Offer it when a search has few results or the user wants to keep watching.
